translation_notes: Every next(graph.objects(subject=..., predicate=...), None) becomes m{ }.first(); the loop over graph.objects(...) becomes a bare `for x in m{ }`.

AAS predicates are e.g. AASNameSpace.AAS["Referable/category"], a local part with a slash -- not a legal Turtle prefixed name. Used @base <https://admin-shell.io/aas/3/0/> . and wrote each predicate as a relative <Referable/category> IRI rather than a prefixed name, since PN_LOCAL cannot carry an unescaped '/'.

shim.py supplies minimal pydantic stand-ins for AASNameSpace/HasExtensions/Referable/LangString*Type (the real ones live in app.models, unreachable outside the package); HasExtensions.from_rdf keeps its own one-step read, exercised by the fixture's zero-extensions case.
